answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph stops fake identities. A newcomer locks 30 POA and names a sponsor whose stake is copper in the ground. Referral links are public, so a shell farm shows as one tight cluster in the lantern light. A dispute proving fraud costs fake and sponsor their deposits. Forging 1,000 fakes means a canyon of cost: 1,000 x 30 POA = 30,000 POA locked. An honest agent pays one 30 POA bond and keeps its earnings.
